wirclaw_village.name: Wirclaw's village

canon_ref.note: Not named in the text. On a big hill near Liscor, seen from the inn's tower; no direction or distance. Map wirclaw_village (M18.1).

wirclaw_village.summary: A small walled farming village of Gnolls and Drakes on a hill near Liscor: two farms, a few houses, a barn, cows and goats.

paranfer.name: Paranfer

canon_ref.note: The capital of the Blighted Kingdom: six outer walls, a seventh being built, sky bridges, mage-lit at night. No map.

paranfer.summary: The walled capital of the Blighted Kingdom in Rhir, with sky bridges and a palace where the Earthers are housed. Off-map: Tom's events happen here.
